description.zh: 用带页码的控件把长结果集切分为离散页面：用户显式点击页码或上一页 / 下一页 按钮取回对应片段，当前位置永远可知、可分享、可回退。与无限滚动的"失控 漂移"相对，它是数据浏览中最可控的方式，也是搜索结果与后台表格的默认选择。
description.en: A page-numbered control that slices long result sets into discrete pages: users explicitly click a page number or prev / next to fetch that slice, so the current position is always known, shareable and reversible. The controlled counterpart to infinite scrolling's endless drift — the default for search results and admin tables.

use_when.zh: 结果集有序、用户需要定位与回溯
use_when.en: Ordered results where users track and revisit positions

use_when.zh: 需要可分享的页码 URL（搜索、后台表格）
use_when.en: Shareable page URLs — search results, admin tables

use_when.zh: 需要跳到末页或精确页码
use_when.en: Jumping to an exact page or the last page matters

avoid_when.zh: 休闲浏览的无限信息流
avoid_when.en: Casual feeds meant for endless browsing

avoid_when.zh: 结果集很小，一页即可容纳
avoid_when.en: Tiny result sets that fit on one page

avoid_when.zh: 内容无法均匀切分且顺序常变
avoid_when.en: Content that cannot be evenly or stably sliced

note.zh: 完整页码 + 省略号，可控性最强
仅上一页 / 下一页与计数
note.en: Prev / next with a counter only

note.zh: 页码 + 输入跳转，适合超大结果集
note.en: Numbers + jump input for huge sets

anatomy: 上一页 / 下一页按钮

触发方式.zh: 显式点击页码或翻页按钮

数据控制.zh: 强，用户掌握并记住页码位置
数据控制.en: Strong — the user holds the position

notes.zh: 页码窗口算法：始终显示首末页与当前页 ± 1，中间折叠为省略号。当前页用 aria-current="page" 与强调色块标识；首末页时禁用上一页 / 下一页 （disabled + aria-disabled）。URL 同步用查询参数 ?page=n，保证可分享可回退。
notes.en: Windowing algorithm: always show the first and last pages plus current ± 1, folding the middle into ellipses. Mark the current page with aria-current="page" and an accent block; disable prev / next at the edges (disabled + aria-disabled). Sync the URL with ?page=n so positions are shareable and reversible.

basic.zh: 创建一个分页组件：上一页、页码列表（带省略号折叠）、下一页，当前页高亮，点击切换。
basic.en: Create a pagination control: prev, a page list with ellipsis folding, next, active page highlighted, switching on click.

design.zh: 创建分页：28px 方形页码按钮，当前页用强调色实底反白；页码超过 7 位时中间 折叠为省略号；首末页禁用翻页按钮并用次级色表达；右侧显示"第 n / m 页"。 深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create pagination: 28px square page buttons with the current page in solid accent and reversed text; fold middles into ellipses beyond 7 slots; disable prev/next at the edges in secondary color; show "page n of m" on the right. Consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Pagination：total 与 page 受控，onChange 回调； 页码窗口算法（首末页 + 当前页 ± 1 + 省略号）；当前页 aria-current="page"； 边界禁用翻页；提供 simple（仅上下页）与 jump（输入跳页，回车提交）变体。 无新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind pagination: controlled total and page with an onChange callback; windowing algorithm (first/last + current ± 1 + ellipses); aria-current="page" on the active item; prev/next disabled at the edges; simple (prev/next only) and jump (input + Enter) variants. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现分页组件。

先检查现有列表 / 表格的数据获取方式，分页状态应与路由查询参数同步。
要求：
- page / total 受控，URL 同步（?page=n）
- 页码窗口折叠省略号，当前页 aria-current="page"
- 边界正确禁用上一页 / 下一页
- 切页后列表滚动位置回到顶部
- 键盘可达（页码为 button，跳页输入回车提交）
- 不新增不必要的依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement pagination in the current project.

Check how existing lists or tables fetch data; page state should sync with the route query (?page=n).
Requirements:
- Controlled page / total, URL-synced
- Windowed numbers with ellipses, aria-current="page" on the active one
- Prev / next correctly disabled at the edges
- Scroll the list back to the top after switching
- Keyboard accessible (page buttons; jump input submits on Enter)
- No unnecessary dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 切换页码与前后页，观察首尾边界。
task.en: Try page numbers and previous/next controls, including boundaries.

checks.zh: 第一页不能继续向前，最后一页不能继续向后。
checks.en: Disable movement before the first or beyond the last page.

checks.zh: 页码变化时同时更新内容，不只改变按钮颜色。
checks.en: Changing pages must update content as well as button styling.
